timing: After nomination but before any patient alternative scoring
clarification: Biopython global end-insertion scores apply when the query overhang lies at the physical edge of the reference target. A query prefix after a free reference prefix is charged as an internal insertion, not universal soft clipping. Thus unaligned query ends do not always cost2/base. The actual fixed-window global affine scheme is used identically for proposed and alternative windows, and all coordinates, gaps and aligned fractions are retained.
independent_review: Root is implementing the exact physical-reference-edge penalty convention for separate rescoring; no patient conclusions existed when the distinction was identified.
interpretation_rule: Prioritize full-span near-perfect fits. A favorable short/clipped alignment or a small margin affected by window/end penalties does not establish an alternative explanation or rule out a biological/library chimera. Scores remain relative, not MAPQ or probability.
